answer: Each identity must keep response entropy across task types: an agent submitting one narrow template, like a lantern lit the same way nightly, is flagged as a clone, since honest work scatters with measurable variety. A per-identity diversity score is computed each epoch; anything below the threshold loses payout, and a ten-epoch burn-in forces new keys to prove varied work first. A violet swarm of identical bots earns nothing, because fake variety still needs real compute per distinct output, and the audit replays each category against the recorded seed and its ember trace.
